description: Add first-class OpenAI API key handling to Swarm Manager so workshop agents can call gpt-image-2. Store the key via the existing internal/secrets encrypted store (VROOLI_SECRETS_KEY pattern). Extend Swarm Manager Settings with a write-only field for configuring the key (never read back to UI as plaintext). Plumb the key into the agent-manager spawn request so sandboxed workshop agents receive it as OPENAI_API_KEY in their environment. Default behavior when unset: image generation helper short-circuits with a clear error. No implicit provider fallback.
name: openai-api-key-plumbing
title: Plumb OpenAI API key into Swarm Manager and agent sandboxes
